notes.title: Controller Hotfix v1.85
notes.content:
An error related to input has been fixed in this hotfix. In some rare cases, the input may somehow remain undefined, that is, the key to be assigned is not accepted by the game engine, so it is not even possible to select a menu. A new script was written to prevent this problem and when opening the main menu, it checks whether there is an enter key in the selection key apart from the normal keys, and if not, it adds an additional enter key. Thus, the situation where the input is completely lost and the menu does not open is solved.

Also achivements about travelling should be fixed.

notes.title: Locked Gates Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello! In the previous hotfix, some of the locked doors could be jumped over due to an error in the collision settings, the collision boxes were extended to fix this, but this time it was too long and caused obstacles in other stages. In this update, all doors were checked one by one and problems in collision settings were corrected.

The scripts of the Suskunlar Hill stage have been edited. We would be very happy if friends who have problems at this stage can test it again and comment.

We apologize for the errors, thank you for your understanding... be sure to write any errors you encounter in the forums, we will try to correct them as much as possible.

notes.title: UMAY UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello friends, we haven't been able to update the game for a long time, this time we are here with a very big update. I say we to be professional, otherwise I have been working alone for a long time.

Unfortunately, you will most likely lose your save files with this update. The game will be installed on your computer from scratch. Because everything, including the code infrastructure, was reconsidered. I hope it will be a much faster, more enjoyable and entertaining game. We do not have a budget to have QA companies test thousands of dollars, you may encounter errors in the game. As you can see, it has been 3 years and I am still updating the game. I will continue to update it as long as there are errors. Please do not hesitate to write about errors via email or on the game's forum pages. It may be read late, but it will definitely be read.

Uruz Update Notes


Image

- adjustments to enemy animations
- New special effects, blood, hits and various explosions
-New stages, tents, statues etc.
- Shows the area that will be damaged before the naphtha explodes
- Multi-Piece naphtha bomb


Software

- The software infrastructure of the game has been completely overhauled, all kinds of hard references have been converted to soft references, and a 20% increase in memory and GPU performance.
-The number of inventory slots has been increased to 24
-new abilities added
- The problem of some features not being saved (such as sound) without first saving has been resolved
- resolved issues with controls and keybinding
-New combo system developed
-Score added to the game
- More than 20 new maps have been added including tents, the total number of maps is over 60
-New item types
- Timed plant system, new trees that grow some items have been added to the natural environment.
-Uruzpedia- interactive objects in the game have been added to the menu as an index

Interface UI

-The interface has been completely redesigned
-Indicators that were not working properly in the interface have been reworked
-Problems in sound settings have been fixed
-New combo animations added
-new in-game interface menus
-new player bar design and interface icons
- Editing the interface and software of runic puzzles

New Game Rule

-When the player levels up, his health is fully charged.
-When the player selects an item from the inventory, walking slows down and he/she picks up the item.
-Combos affect hit coefficient
-Damage calculation: base damage+weapon damage+combo bonus damage
-Removed in-game real-time map
- The player is not affected by the arrows and items thrown by the enemy while dashing


Artificial intelligence

-Enemies can jump towards the player (here there may be errors such as excessive flying, jumping, etc. due to the physics engine, we are working on it)
-Added fainting feature to enemies
- Enemies' dead bodies do not disappear
- Adjustments to the flight algorithms of flying enemies

new item
- Kapu portal item (teleport) that opens a portal directly to Kam Ata's tent
- Letters as quest items
- New special items; Rings with health boosting, attack and armor bonuses

Thank you for reading, by the way I have a daughter and her name is Umay, I named this update after her :)

notes.title: Deprem Yardım Kampanyası
notes.content:
Hello friends, I wanted to make a campaign to support Earthquake aid within my own capabilities. Uruz is on sale from now on and I will donate all the proceeds of the sale on Steam during the 14-day sale to Afad (Turkish state disaster relief fund). In general, 400-500 pieces are sold during discount times, I hope this time it will be sold more. I will also share the sales figures. I look forward to your support.

Ali Can Meydan founder Berzah Games
